title: Search Provider
description: A provider-neutral search-provider binding. The contract names no concrete provider: a search backend is identified only by an opaque host-framework-identifier and an opaque catalogue-identifier the consumer supplies at wiring time. Any string is accepted for those identifiers, so adding a provider requires no contract change. The failure policy enum is closed, so an unknown on-failure policy fails closed instead of silently degrading.

hostFrameworkIdentifier.description: Opaque identifier of the host framework that executes the search call. No concrete provider name is required or permitted by this contract; the value is supplied by the consumer.

catalogueIdentifier.description: Opaque identifier of the search capability within a catalogue. Decoupled from any vendor naming so the same contract serves every provider.

onFailure.description: Closed set of failure policies. An unknown policy fails closed.
